'''2014 European Championship Reset Beta Marvin Tegeler LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Marvin Tegeler]] at [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Marvin Tegeler]]
* '''Event:''' [[2014 European Championship Reset Beta]]
* '''Stage:''' Results
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]] <small>(inferred: no Objective; Throne Room Mains start)</small>
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]]
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2014-europeans-reset-beta-event-12th-place-ls-marvin-tegeler-trm/ PC list]
